steps.title: Initialize Project
steps.description: Creates a modern Next.js project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, an absolute src directory structure, and the App Router pre-configured.

steps.title: Navigate into Directory
steps.description: Changes your current working directory to the newly generated project folder.

steps.title: Verify TypeScript Config
steps.description: Inspects the auto-generated configuration mapping paths and strict typing rules for compilation.

steps.title: Start Local Development Server
steps.description: Spins up a hot-reloading development server accessible in your browser at http://localhost:3000.
